title: Waveform, sample rate and spectrograms: ComfyUI's AUDIO type
hook: An AUDIO value is a tensor and a number. Most audio bugs in graphs come from forgetting the number.

verified.claim: AUDIO is a dict of waveform [batch, channels, samples] and sample_rate.
AudioAdjustVolume multiplies by 10 ** (dB / 20) and does not clip.
AudioConcat doubles mono to stereo, and match_audio_sample_rates resamples the lower rate up.
H3's audio VAE uses 32000 Hz. Music 3's DAV takes the default 44100 Hz.
nm_audio and e_audio_channels validate and run on a CPU.
Gallery files read with ffprobe: H3 32000 Hz stereo, LTX 48000 Hz stereo, the Music 3 score 44100 Hz stereo.

unchecked: We searched for a general spectrogram node in core and found only internal functions inside model code. A later version may add one, and packs may have one. We did not survey packs for this lesson.
Whether a save node clips values above 1.0 depends on the codec. We did not test each format.
